name: rpw-linkedin-intro
description: 25s LinkedIn intro video for RPW Technical Consulting, rendered with HyperFrames

scripts.render: npm run render:landscape && npm run render:square && npm run render:vertical
scripts.render:landscape: node build.mjs landscape && hyperframes render -o renders/rpw-intro-landscape.mp4 -q delivery
scripts.render:square: node build.mjs square && hyperframes render -o renders/rpw-intro-square.mp4 -q delivery
scripts.render:vertical: node build.mjs vertical && hyperframes render -o renders/rpw-intro-vertical.mp4 -q delivery
